sentences.text:
Susil Chandra Pal & Ors vs The State Of West Bengal & Anr on 7
June, 2023

Author: Tirthankar Ghosh
Bench: Tirthankar Ghosh

07.06.2023 In The High Court At Calcutta
Item No.11 Criminal Revisional Jurisdiction
Ct.No.34
 dc.
 C.R.R. 4262 of 2022
 Susil Chandra Pal & Ors.
 versus
 The State of West Bengal & Anr.
 In Re: An Application under Section 483 read with Section
 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973.

Mr. Mujibar Ali Naskar,
 Mr. Parvez Hossain ...
For the Petitioners.
Md. Anwar Hossain,
Ms. Sreyashee Biswas ...
For the State.

The present revisional application has been preferred
 praying for expeditious disposal of the proceedings arising out
 of Rishra Police Station Case No. 34 of 2016 dated
 04.03.2016 under Sections 498A/406/307 of the Indian
 Penal Code pending before learned Judicial Magistrate, 5th
 Court, Serampore, Hooghly.
 Learned advocate appearing for the petitioners, at the
 very inception, submits that he has instructions that all the
 witnesses have been examined except the investigating officer
 whose date for evidence has been fixed on 28.06.2023.
 Learned advocate for the petitioner is directed to serve
Susil Chandra Pal & Ors vs The State Of West Bengal & Anr on 7 June, 2023

1 

 a copy of this revisional application upon Ms. Sreyashee  Biswas, learned advocate, who ordinarily appears for the  State
. Her appointment may be regularised by the concerned  authorities.

Having regard to the fact that trial of the case, so far as  the evidence of the prosecution is concerned, is towards the  end, I direct that the learned Magistrate would take steps so  2 that the evidence of the investigating officer is concluded on 28.06.2023 or within a month thereafter.

Learned court thereafter within a month would complete the examination under Section 313 of the Code of Criminal Procedure of all the accused persons and afford another two months for the defence to adduce its evidence.
The learned trial court thereafter would take efforts so that the verdict of the case is delivered by 30.11.2023.

With the aforesaid observations, the revisional application being CRR 4262 of 2022 is disposed of.
Pending connected application, if any, is consequently disposed of.
All parties shall act on the server copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.
Urgent photostat certified copy of this order, if applied for, be supplied to the parties upon compliance with all requisite formalities.

(Tirthankar Ghosh, J.)
